# archestra_site_notification (Resource)

The organization's site notification: a banner every member sees. An organization has one notification, so declare this resource once; creating it replaces the current notification, and destroying it removes the banner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_site_notification" "maintenance" {
  content     = "Archestra is upgraded on Saturday from 09:00 to 10:00 UTC."
  expires_at  = "2030-01-04T10:00:00Z"
  dismissible = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Text of the banner. Markdown is supported.

### Optional

- `dismissible` (Boolean) Whether members can close the banner.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time after which the banner is hidden.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the banner is shown.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Notification ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_site_notification.maintenance <notification id>
```
